g.text: The factory may pollute. Does the smoke have to stay?
Simplified: two sides, free bargaining, costs known.
Smoke costs a laundry $300 a year; a filter, $100 a year.
The factory may legally pollute. If they bargain freely, is the filter fitted?
No, the factory has the right
Yes, the laundry pays for it
Only if a court orders it
The factory may pollute. Does the smoke have to stay?
Simplified: two sides, free bargaining, costs known.
Hint: make offers as the laundry, then choose for a liable factory.
The factory may pollute. Does the smoke have to stay?
Simplified: two sides, free bargaining, costs known.
Your $200 sat in the band: above the $100 filter, below the
$300 of smoke, so both gained. Liable, the factory fitted it
itself: $100 beats $300. Both Totals: −$100. The right only
decided who pays. Coase theorem: needs free bargaining.
